---
name: Capability blocker escalation
about: Resolve an apparent tool/connector limitation without weakening controls
labels: capability-blocker
---

# Objective
State the outcome that must be achieved.

# Current execution-path limitation
Identify the connector/tool/agent/environment limitation precisely.

# Authorized alternatives checked
Document direct API, alternate connectors, GitHub-native agent delegation, workflows/Apps/CLI/MCP, remote execution, and any other already-authorized paths considered.

# Required authority
State the exact permission/capability required. Do not assume broader access than necessary.

# Proposed safe path
Describe the smallest reversible method that can meet the original acceptance criteria.

# Prohibited shortcuts
List controls that must not be weakened or bypassed.

# Verification
Define independent evidence that proves the blocker is actually resolved.

# Reusable lesson review
If this pattern can recur, identify which durable standards/instructions/tests should be updated before closure.
